subject: Encryption evidence delivery & checksum / SFTP plan (SOC 2 / SIG items)
messages:
From: Emily Torres <emily.torres@clearpoint.com>
To: chloe_martin@redwood.ai
Cc: security@clearpoint.com
Date: 2028-07-16T08:14:00-07:00
Subject: SOC2 / SIG: KMS + HSM artifacts - initial ask

Hi Chloe,

Thanks again for taking the time this morning. ClearPoint's compliance team is preparing our vendor pack and we need a bundle of artifacts related to key management for the SOC 2 / SIG review. Specifically we've requested: sample KMS audit logs for the last 30 days, an HSM attestation (signed), the key rotation index for customer-managed keys, and an access matrix for KMS/HSM operators.

Can you confirm whether Redwood can deliver these as a password-protected archive via an SFTP drop or if you prefer a secure Share link? Also please confirm whether any of these artifacts contain tenant identifiers so we can advise our legal team on redaction scope.

Appreciate a quick ETA — our deadline to close this control is EOD Friday.

Best,
Emily
Emily Torres
Senior Security Analyst, ClearPoint Systems
From: chloe_martin@redwood.ai
To: Emily Torres <emily.torres@clearpoint.com>
Cc: jonas_weber@redwood.ai, irene_choi@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-07-16T08:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SOC2 / SIG: KMS + HSM artifacts - initial ask

Emily —

Thanks — we can deliver the artifacts by SFTP as an encrypted tarball and provide SHA256 checksums and a separate password transfer over DocuSign (or a short phone call if you prefer). Quick answers to your questions:

- Scope: the bundle we propose contains redwood operational metadata only; no ClearPoint tenant data will be included. Where logs reference tenant identifiers we will scrub or replace with deterministic tokens (example: tenant-<redacted>).
- Artifacts we will include: KMS audit logs (sample 30-day extract), signed HSM attestation, key-rotation index export, operator access matrix, and a short README describing how we generated the samples (timeline, sampling windows).
- Delivery: SFTP host (provided below), encrypted archive (.tar.gpg), SHA256 sums in a .sha256 file, and an assertion PDF signed by our Security Ops lead.

Proposed ETA: 2028-07-16 16:00 PDT. If that meets your schedule we'll proceed.

SFTP details (will rotate credentials at creation):
Host: sftp.clearpoint-delivery.redwoodinternal.net
Path: /incoming/clearpoint/20280716-evidence

I'll also loop in Legal if you want a redaction approval workflow.

Thanks,
Chloe Martin
Manager, Compliance Operations
Redwood Inference
From: jonas_weber@redwood.ai
To: chloe_martin@redwood.ai, Emily Torres <emily.torres@clearpoint.com>
Cc: irene_choi@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-07-16T09:35:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SOC2 / SIG: KMS + HSM artifacts - initial ask

Emily / Chloe —

A couple of implementation notes from the runtime side so ClearPoint knows what to expect:

- KMS logs: These are extracted from our audit ingestion pipeline. Timestamps are in UTC and the extract includes event types: CreateKey, Encrypt, Decrypt, RotateKey, GrantAccess, RevokeAccess. Sensitive fields (ciphertexts, raw key material) are never present in logs.
- HSM attestation: We will provide the vendor-signed attestation (FIPS+module serial) and a short operational statement describing backup/replication frequency.
- Rotation index: CSV will include key_id (hashed), last_rotation_utc, rotation_policy_id. We will add a mapping file showing how hashed key_id maps to Redwood internal ids (hashed with a per-run salt) — this helps auditors reconcile without exposing key material.

I will generate the rotation_index_sample.csv and kms_access_matrix_20280716.csv and place them in the archive. Checksums will be generated via sha256sum.

-Jonas
Jonas Weber
Principal Infra Engineer, Serving Runtime
Redwood Inference
From: Emily Torres <emily.torres@clearpoint.com>
To: chloe_martin@redwood.ai
Cc: security@clearpoint.com
Date: 2028-07-16T10:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SOC2 / SIG: KMS + HSM artifacts - initial ask

Chloe / Jonas —

That plan works. A few clarifications before delivery:

1) Please include the SHA256 sums at the top-level in a file named checksums.sha256.
2) For the HSM attestation, can you include the certificate chain and the signing timestamp?
3) Regarding redaction/scrubbing: replacing tenant IDs with deterministic tokens is fine; include a short mapping README that explains the tokenization approach (salted hash, salt retained by Redwood only).
4) We need the archive password exchanged via a separate channel. DocuSign is fine. If you prefer, we can accept an emailed one-time secret from the procurement contact once the SFTP is confirmed.

If you can drop by 16:00 PDT that's perfect — we'll confirm receipt and start internal review.

Thanks,
Emily
From: chloe_martin@redwood.ai
To: Emily Torres <emily.torres@clearpoint.com>
Cc: jonas_weber@redwood.ai, irene_choi@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-07-16T11:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SOC2 / SIG: KMS + HSM artifacts - initial ask

Emily —

Confirmed: archive will be named redwood_kms_audit_sample_20280716.tar.gpg and checksums stored in checksums.sha256. HSM attestation will include certificate chain and a signed timestamp PDF (hsm_attestation_signed_clearpoint_v1.pdf). The README will explain tokenization and include the salt lifecycle notes (salt retained by Redwood, not shared).

We will push the encrypted archive and checksums to the SFTP path by 16:00 PDT and initiate a DocuSign envelope for the one-time password. DocuSign envelope id: DOCU-783921 (you should receive the secure note from no-reply@docusign.net).

Attachments in the drop will be:
- redwood_kms_audit_sample_20280716.tar.gpg (GPG-encrypted tarball)
- checksums.sha256
- hsm_attestation_signed_clearpoint_v1.pdf
- rotation_index_sample.csv
- kms_access_matrix_20280716.csv
- README-sampling-and-tokenization.txt

If ClearPoint needs additional redactions after review, please send a redaction request ticket to compliance@redwood.ai and we will triage within one business day.

Thanks for the quick turnaround — will update when the SFTP drop is complete.

Regards,
Chloe Martin
Manager, Compliance Operations
Redwood Inference
